title: Share of the Accessory Kit Borne on a PAP Therapy Equipment Return, by Days Kept
content:
# Share of the Accessory Kit Borne on a PAP Therapy Equipment Return, by Days Kept

**Clause.** How much of the value of the used accessories — the mask value and the tubing value — a patient bears when a self-pay PAP Therapy Equipment unit comes back to Summit Ridge on a completed return pickup request depends on how long the unit was kept and on the patient's **PAP Supply Replenishment Program** enrollment:

- a patient with an active supply enrollment who kept the unit **more than 14 days** bears the mask value plus the tubing value prorated over the **90-day** replacement period of the tubing — the tubing value multiplied by the days kept and divided by 90;
- a patient who kept the unit **14 days or less** bears the mask value only, the tubing set being cleaned and restocked;
- any other patient bears the full kit value, the mask value plus the tubing value.

**Days kept.** Counted from the delivery date on the device record to the date the completed return pickup request records the unit as received back (that request's decision date): calendar days from the one date to the other, the delivery date itself not counted. An active enrollment is a PAP Supply Replenishment Program enrollment of the patient in status active. The prorated tubing value is carried unrounded.

## Combinations

| Active supply enrollment | Days kept | Patient bears |
|---|---|---|
| yes | more than 14 | mask value plus tubing value multiplied by days kept, divided by 90 |
| yes | 14 or less | mask value only |
| no | 14 or less | mask value only |
| no | more than 14 | mask value plus tubing value (full kit) |

## Worked figures (hypothetical: mask value 89.00, tubing value 15.00)

- Active enrollment, 30 days kept: 15.00 multiplied by 30 and divided by 90 is 5.00; borne 89.00 plus 5.00, or 94.00.
- Active enrollment, 20 days kept: 15.00 multiplied by 20 and divided by 90 is 3.3333…; borne 92.3333…, carried unrounded.
- Active enrollment, 14 days kept: borne 89.00, the mask only.
- No active enrollment, 15 days kept: borne 104.00, the full kit.
